Name: Sam is Goku
Author: SuperPiggeh778
Description:
I turned Sam into Goku...

Anyways instructions in case you've never installed a XNB mod before...

1. [b]EITHER BACKUP ORIGINAL SAM.XNB OR [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2275]INSTALL XNB LOADER[/url][/b]
2. Open the downloaded zip file, navigate to Sam.xnb, and either put it in your game's content folder or in XnbLoader's ModContent folder. 
3. Load up the game, stand outside Sam's house until he comes out, then talk to him to see how bad I am at making portraits. 

Hope you enjoy this, sorry for my lack of image editing skills :p
